global: This is spicy ramen in a rich, red broth, topped with a whole boiled egg, chashu pork, shredded cabbage, and sprouts, arranged neatly in a white bowl. It sits on a black tray, illuminated warmly, highlighting the vibrant colors and textures of the dish.

regions.background: Black tray with smooth, slightly reflective surface, rectangular shape, bordered by reddish-brown wooden edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface and thin, even rim showing faint orange residue.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green sprouts, shredded toppings, and a soft-boiled egg, all nestled in a white bowl.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellow with a smooth, slightly glossy surface, sits nestled in the ramen broth.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, glistening slices with marbled fat, slightly curled edges, and a savory sheen from the broth.
